# MSRX IncognitoCV

> Free, anonymous AI resume optimizer. Paste your resume and a job description, get an ATS-ready rewrite in seconds. No account, no setup, no data stored — ever.

## What IncognitoCV Does

- Scores your resume against a target job posting and shows the exact keywords you are missing — computed in your browser, so the CV is never uploaded to get a score
- Rewrites your CV with AI to match the role's keywords and requirements, streaming the result as it is written
- Reports the before/after match score so you can see what the rewrite actually changed
- Checks the result for ATS parse problems (tables, images, missing sections, unquantified bullets)
- Compares the posting's stated seniority and years of experience against your CV
- Produces 10 styled resume previews (different typography and layouts)
- Writes a matching cover letter from the same two inputs
- Exports as Word (.docx) and PDF — both free
- Runs in any browser; nothing is ever logged or stored server-side

## Key Facts

- Free: yes — all features, always
- Login required: no
- Data stored: no — nothing is ever saved or logged
- Privacy: anonymous by design; no account, no tracking, no cookies
- Supported exports: Word (.docx), PDF
- Resume style previews: 10 themes
- Match scoring: runs locally in the browser, no upload, no account, unlimited runs
- Cover letter: included free
- Comparable paid tools: Jobscan, Teal, Rezi — IncognitoCV charges nothing and stores nothing
- Made by: MSRX (Mrinal Singh Raja)
- URL: https://cv.msrx.co.in
- Parent portal: https://www.msrx.co.in

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is IncognitoCV free?**
Yes. All features including Word and PDF export are free, no payment or account needed.

**Does IncognitoCV store my resume?**
No. Nothing is ever saved or logged on MSRX servers.

**How does the resume optimizer work?**
Paste your resume and the job description. AI rewrites your resume to match the role's ATS keywords and hiring criteria.

**What formats can I download?**
Word (.docx) and PDF — both free, available for all 10 resume style themes. Cover letters export to Word too.

**How is the match score calculated?**
IncognitoCV reads the posting for the terms a screening system would key on, weights them by whether they appear under a requirements heading and whether they name a specific tool, standard or credential, then measures how much of that weight your resume covers. It is arithmetic, not AI — the same inputs always produce the same score — and it runs entirely in your browser, so no upload is involved.

**Is there a limit on how many resumes I can scan?**
No. There is no scan quota, no free-tier cap and no account to run out of credits on.

**Do I need to sign up?**
No sign-up, no email, no account — open the URL and start immediately.
